kjv: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better
mine: If the serpent bites before it is charmed, there is no advantage to the charmer
note: Hebrew ba'al hallashon "master of the tongue" is the snake-charmer (cf. Ps 58:5, Jer 8:17); bel' lachash is "before/without charming". The point is skill used too late, not babblers.
